academicYears.description: Register each academic year here before it's used on student forms, imports, or year-end promotion.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Mother tongue options on the student form.

documentTypes.title: Document types
documentTypes.description: Used when uploading student verification documents.

editDialog.title: Edit {{label}}

deactivateDialog.title: Deactivate {{label}}
deactivateDialog.description: Deactivate "{{value}}"? It will no longer appear in dropdowns.

academicYears.empty: No academic years yet. Add one to start using it in student forms, imports, and promotion.
academicYears.setCurrentSuccess: {{label}} is now the current academic year
academicYears.setCurrentError: Could not set current academic year

addDialog.title: Add academic year
addDialog.description: Register a new academic year (e.g. 2027-28) so it can be used on student forms, imports, and year-end promotion.
addDialog.datesRequired: Start and end dates are required
addDialog.endAfterStart: End date must be after the start date
addDialog.setCurrent: Set as the current academic year

editDialog.title: Edit academic year
editDialog.description: Update the label or dates. This does not change which year is current — use "Set as current" for that.
